<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#> .
@prefix vocab:<https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .

# Shape targeting all ship instances (owner class as per admission)
vocab:ShipRuleLengthShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:ship ;

    # ruleLength must be present and be a QUDT QuantityValue
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:ruleLength ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:message "Each ship must have exactly one ruleLength quantity value." ;
    ] ;

    # classificationSocietyRuleLength must be present and be a QUDT QuantityValue
    sh:property [
        sh:path vocab:classificationSocietyRuleLength ;
        sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:maxCount 1 ;
        sh:message "Each ship must have exactly one classificationSocietyRuleLength quantity value." ;
    ] ;

    # Both quantities must have the same numeric value and the same unit (metre)
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "The ruleLength must be equal to the classification society rule length – numeric value or unit differs." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this ?rlVal ?cslVal ?rlUnit ?cslUnit WHERE {
                $this vocab:ruleLength ?rl .
                $this vocab:classificationSocietyRuleLength ?csl .
                ?rl qudt:numericValue ?rlVal .
                ?csl qudt:numericValue ?cslVal .
                ?rl qudt:unit ?rlUnit .
                ?csl qudt:unit ?cslUnit .
                FILTER ( ?rlVal != ?cslVal || ?rlUnit != ?cslUnit )
            }
        """ ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>

We need to revise previous SHACL. Issues: 1) canonical identifier error: using sh:class with identifier "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#QuantityValue" wrong; should be "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/QuantityValue". So replace sh:class usage at line 16 (property block). Also later second property uses same.

2) SPARQL error: the sh:select string is invalid. Need proper SELECT query syntax. The original tries to SELECT $this ...; Should be a SELECT query that returns ?this or ?this ??? In SHACL SPARQL constraint, we use sh:select with a SELECT query that returns ?this (or ?this) and any violation. Typically format:

SELECT $this (?rlVal AS ?actualValue) WHERE {
  $this vocab:ruleLength ?rl .
  $this vocab:classificationSocietyRuleLength ?csl .
  ?rl qudt:numericValue ?rlVal .
  ?csl qudt:numericValue ?cslVal .
  ?rl qudt:unit ?rlUnit .
  ?csl qudt:unit ?cslUnit .
  FILTER ( ?rlVal != ?cslVal || ?rlUnit != ?cslUnit )
}

But need SELECT ?this? Actually $this is allowed variable referencing the focus node, but must be used as ?this? In examples uses $this as variable. SELECT ?this ... where ?this is the focus node variable? In SHACL, $this is substituted with focus node before execution; query cannot contain $this directly? Actually the query can refer to $this; Ts. It should be SELECT $this WHERE { ... } but also need to make it a SELECT Query not SELECT.

The parse error "Expected SelectQuery, found '(' (at char 26), (line:2, col:26)". Probably because extra parentheses in string? The string includes triple quotes; inside we have SELECT $this ( ?rlVal ?cslVal ?rlUnit ?cslUnit ) WHERE {. That's illegal because SELECT $this ( ?rlVal ?cslVal ...) is not valid SPARQL syntax. Should be SELECT $this ?rlVal ?cslVal ?rlUnit ?cslUnit WHERE {. Or use SELECT $this WHERE { ... FILTER ... } and use sh:message to produce string.

So we modify sh:sparql block:

sh:sparql [
  a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
  sh:message "The ruleLength must be equal to classificationSocietyRuleLength – numeric value or unit differs." ;

      ?rl qudt:unit ?rlUnit .
      ?csl qudt:unit ?cslUnit .
      FILTER ( ?rlVal != ?cslVal || ?rlUnit != ?cslUnit )
    }
  """ ;
] .
